scripts.test:ingress: pnpm -s run ingress:up:build && pnpm -s run smoke:ingress && pnpm -s run ingress:down
scripts.test:ingress:reachability: pnpm -s run ingress:up:build && pnpm -s run smoke:ingress:reachability && pnpm -s run ingress:down
scripts.test:pdns: pnpm -s run pdns:up:build && pnpm -s run smoke:pdns && pnpm -s run pdns:down
scripts.test:pdns:api: pnpm -s run pdns:up:build && pnpm -s run smoke:pdns:api && pnpm -s run pdns:down
scripts.ingress:up: docker compose --profile ingress up -d postgres broker rathole traefik && docker compose --profile ingress up -d rathole-sidecar
scripts.ingress:up:build: docker compose --profile ingress up -d --build postgres broker rathole traefik && docker compose --profile ingress up -d --build rathole-sidecar
scripts.pdns:up: docker compose --profile pdns up -d postgres broker pdns
scripts.pdns:up:build: docker compose --profile pdns up -d --build postgres broker pdns
